headline: Bliss GVS Pharma Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Bliss GVS Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Letter of Offer dated July 18, 2026 received from SBI Capital Markets Limited, the manager to the Open Offer appointed by Anupam Rasayan India Limited along with PAC'.
